opportunity.title: The gap — and why it's the opportunity
opportunity.body: Short-form clips regularly do 15–20k views off a following of a few hundred. The content outperforms the infrastructure by a factor of thirty. That gap isn't a content problem — it's a capture problem, and it's the single thing this platform is built to close: one destination, one audience, one set of numbers.
